title: NIST SP 800-53B (organization-defined parameters)

maxLoginFailures.source: FedRAMP Rev5 Moderate baseline AC-7 a: three (3) consecutive invalid logon attempts

lockoutWindowSeconds.source: FedRAMP Rev5 Moderate baseline AC-7 a: during a fifteen (15) minute time period

minLockoutSeconds.source: FedRAMP Rev5 Moderate baseline AC-7 b: lock the account for thirty (30) minutes or until released by an administrator

requireAdminRelease.source: FedRAMP Rev5 Moderate baseline AC-7 b (time-based release permitted)

maxSessionIdleSeconds.source: FedRAMP Rev5 Moderate baseline AC-11 a: fifteen (15) minutes of inactivity

maxSessionLifespanSeconds.source: No FedRAMP value (organization-defined); 12 hours is this pack's default

minPasswordLength.source: FedRAMP Rev5 IA-5(1) defers to NIST SP 800-63B; SP 800-63B-4 section 3.1.1.2 requires at least 15 characters for a password used as a single factor

minLogRetentionDays.source: FedRAMP Rev5 AU-11: a time period in compliance with OMB M-21-31 (12 months active storage, 18 months cold storage)

provenance: NIST SP 800-53B assigns no values to organization-defined parameters. The low / moderate / high profiles use the FedRAMP Rev5 values (cited per parameter) as placeholders; set your organization's values in settings controlsEngine.parameters.
